% A memoir document: a chapter with lists, a bibliography with memoir's
% \bibitemsep (memoir has no \bibparsep, which biblatex adds), and sections
% spaced by memoir's \setbeforesecskip. Two headings are redefined: one with
% \@startsection only inside \@ifstar's groups, and one with \par first.
\documentclass{memoir}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\setlength{\bibitemsep}{6pt}
\setbeforesecskip{-5ex}
\makeatletter
\renewcommand\subsubsection{\@ifstar{\@startsection{subsubsection}{3}{\z@}{1ex}{1ex}{\bfseries}*}%
    {\@startsection{subsubsection}{3}{\z@}{1ex}{1ex}{\bfseries}}}
\renewcommand\paragraph{\par\@startsection{paragraph}{4}{\z@}{2ex}{1ex}{\bfseries}}
\makeatother
\title{Memoir}
\author{Someone}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
\tableofcontents
\chapter{First}
\section{A section}
Some text, as cited in \cite{book} and \cite{paper}.
\begin{itemize}
    \item One,
    \begin{itemize}
        \item inside.
    \end{itemize}
    \item two.
\end{itemize}
\begin{enumerate}
    \item First,
    \item second.
\end{enumerate}
\begin{thebibliography}{9}
\bibitem{book} A.~Author. \emph{A Book}. 2000.
\bibitem{paper} B.~Writer. A paper. 2001.
\end{thebibliography}
\end{document}
